description: Robauto Technical Groundwork: homepage Accept negotiation. Serve the committed index.md twin when Accept contains text/markdown. GitHub Pages cannot do this with static files alone.
notes: Homepage only. No sitemap expansion. No robots.txt Content Signals. No OpenAPI, agent cards, MCP, OAuth, x402, or commerce surfaces.
GitHub Pages cannot emit Accept negotiation. islandmountain.io is proxied by Cloudflare in front of Pages. These are three additive rules in three phases. Do not PUT any whole ruleset.

Tokens is ceil(character_count / 4) of the committed index.md UTF-8 body, a conventional English token estimate. Recompute and update the Tokens header value if the twin changes. Header name: Tokens (not X-Markdown-Tokens).

http.request.uri.path is the original client path. After the URL rewrite, origin fetches /index.md but response-header and cache expressions still see / or /index.html. Match both the homepage paths (with Accept) and a direct /index.md fetch.

Cloudflare's default cache key is the original URL, so a cached HTML homepage would otherwise be served to markdown Accept. The cache rule bypasses cache for that Accept on / and /index.html only. HTML cache for browsers stays.

Do not edit the existing security-header rewrite, the homepage Link rule (ref homepage_rfc9727_link_headers), the Tier A COOP/HSTS rule (ref tier_a_coop_hsts_preload), or the api-catalog Content-Type rule owned by PR #14 (ref api_catalog_linkset_json_content_type).

dashboard: 1) URL Rewrite. Cloudflare Dashboard > islandmountain.io > Rules > Overview > Transform Rules > Rewrite URL. Add a new rule. Custom filter: (http.request.uri.path eq "/" or http.request.uri.path eq "/index.html") and any(http.request.headers["accept"][*] contains "text/markdown"). Then rewrite Path to Static /index.md. Deploy. If this is the first URL Rewrite on the zone, creating the phase ruleset with this one rule is OK. If other URL Rewrites already exist, add this rule only.

2) Response headers. Rules > Transform Rules > Modify Response Header. Add a new rule. Do not edit the security-header rewrite, homepage Link rule, Tier A rule, or api-catalog Content-Type rule. Custom filter: (http.request.uri.path eq "/index.md") or ((http.request.uri.path eq "/" or http.request.uri.path eq "/index.html") and any(http.request.headers["accept"][*] contains "text/markdown")). Set static Content-Type = text/markdown; charset=utf-8. Set static Vary = Accept. Set static Tokens = 1696. Deploy. Confirm the older header rules stay enabled.

3) Cache bypass. Rules > Cache Rules. Add a new rule. Custom filter: (http.request.uri.path eq "/" or http.request.uri.path eq "/index.html") and any(http.request.headers["accept"][*] contains "text/markdown"). Then: Bypass cache. Deploy. Do not replace existing cache rules.
api: Additive create-rule only. Do not PUT a ruleset with a rules array that contains only these rules if that ruleset already has live rules.

URL Rewrite: GET /zones/$ZONE_ID/rulesets/phases/http_request_transform/entrypoint. If missing, create a zone ruleset for that phase with the rewrite object below. If present, POST /zones/$ZONE_ID/rulesets/$REWRITE_RULESET_ID/rules with the rewrite object.

Response headers: POST /zones/$ZONE_ID/rulesets/$HEADER_RULESET_ID/rules with the headers object. Header ruleset id from prior Link / Tier A work: c0fae000097143e0ba49736efbe36c87. Confirm with GET /zones/$ZONE_ID/rulesets/phases/http_response_headers_transform/entrypoint if that id is ever rotated.

Cache: GET /zones/$ZONE_ID/rulesets/phases/http_request_cache_settings/entrypoint. If missing, create a zone ruleset for that phase with the cache object below. If present, POST /zones/$ZONE_ID/rulesets/$CACHE_RULESET_ID/rules with the cache object.
